full_text_en:
**XJ Electric Co., Ltd. v. Zheng Xuesheng, Luohe Aite Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. — Trade Secret Infringement Dispute**

**Plaintiff:** XJ Electric Co., Ltd., Xuchang City, Henan Province  
**Legal Representative:** Wang Jinian, General Manager  
**Agent ad litem:** He Guanghua, Deputy General Manager of XJ Electric Co., Ltd.  
**Agent ad litem:** Zhao Guolan, Attorney at Henan Wuhuan Law Firm  

**Defendant:** Zheng Xuesheng, male, 32 years old, Chief Engineer of Luohe Aite Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd., Henan Province  
**Agent ad litem:** Guo Jianghua, Attorney at Henan Xuchang Qiushi Law Firm  

**Defendant:** Luohe Aite Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd., Henan Province  
**Legal Representative:** Li Aihua, Manager  
**Agent ad litem:** Ju Shunxing, Attorney at Henan Xuchang Qiushi Law Firm  

The Plaintiff, XJ Electric Co., Ltd., Xuchang City, Henan Province (hereinafter referred to as "XJ Company"), filed a lawsuit with the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province against the Defendants Zheng Xuesheng and Luohe Aite Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd., Henan Province (hereinafter referred to as "Aite Company") for trade secret infringement.

**Plaintiff's Allegations:** During his employment with the Plaintiff, Defendant Zheng Xuesheng acquired the Plaintiff's power line carrier technology. Defendant Aite Company, by offering inducements in the form of technology as capital contributions, used the technical secrets illegally provided by Zheng Xuesheng to manufacture power line carriers, thereby infringing upon the Plaintiff's trade secrets. The Plaintiff requested the court to order Zheng Xuesheng to compensate for losses of RMB 135,000 caused by his unilateral termination of the labor contract; to order both Zheng Xuesheng and Aite Company to cease the infringement, compensate the Plaintiff for economic losses, undertake a duty of confidentiality regarding the Plaintiff's trade secrets, and bear the litigation costs of this case.

**Defendant Zheng Xuesheng:** No defense submitted.

**Defendant Aite Company's Defense:** The Plaintiff's claims are not based on facts; the Defendant has not infringed upon the Plaintiff's trade secrets.

**Facts Found by the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province:**

On December 10, 1984, the predecessor of the Plaintiff XJ Company, Xuchang Relay Factory, signed a "License and Technical Know-How Contract for Relay Protection Power Line Carrier Equipment" with Siemens AG of Germany, acquiring Siemens' relay protection and carrier technology through a paid technology transfer. Pursuant to the contract, XJ Company paid 620,446 Deutsche Marks to Siemens on December 21, 1985, to purchase the carrier equipment license documentation, and from May to August 1986, sent Defendant Zheng Xuesheng to Siemens for technical training. Subsequently, XJ Company organized a research team including Zheng Xuesheng for the domestic development of the carrier technology. As one of the project leaders, Zheng Xuesheng participated in the development of the ESB-500 type single-sideband power line carrier. In January 1992, the ESB-500 type single-sideband power line carrier technology passed the appraisal of the Ministry of Machinery Industry and the Ministry of Energy, was put into production, and yielded significant benefits. XJ Company had formulated confidentiality regulations for its product base drawings, blueprints, process materials, and technical materials in 1987 and 1989 respectively. Throughout the development of the ESB-500 type single-sideband power line carrier technology and after its successful completion, XJ Company maintained confidentiality management and never transferred or disclosed the technology to any entity or individual.

Defendant Zheng Xuesheng was assigned to work for the Plaintiff XJ Company after graduating from university in 1983. During this period, apart from serving as one of the project leaders in XJ Company's power line carrier technology development, Zheng Xuesheng also served as a project leader from February 1991 to April 1992 in the technical development of the YPC-500F6 remote protection signal audio transmission device, responsible for the overall machine and principle design. On March 25, 1992, Zheng Xuesheng signed an 11-year "Comprehensive Labor Contract" with XJ Company, which stipulated that Zheng Xuesheng must comply with the company's various rules and regulations. In September of the same year, XJ Company's Communication Branch employed Zheng Xuesheng as an engineer, and Zheng Xuesheng signed a five-year employment agreement with the Communication Branch, agreeing to strictly implement all rules and regulations and the technical standards for design work, and to maintain confidentiality. In October 1994, Zheng Xuesheng valued the power line carrier technology and the remote protection signal audio transmission device technology he had mastered at RMB 200,000 as a capital contribution, and together with Luohe Cigarette Factory, Zhang Mingliang, and others, established Defendant Aite Company. Aite Company commenced formal operations in November 1994. In May 1995, without approval, Zheng Xuesheng left XJ Company to work for Aite Company.

Apart from Defendant Zheng Xuesheng, Defendant Aite Company had no other researchers engaged in power line carrier and remote protection signal transmission device technology. The company had also not conducted any "reverse engineering" on XJ Company's power line carrier and remote protection signal transmission device products. In September 1995, Aite Company published a "Communication Products Quotation List of Aite Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd.," in which the average price of the SSB-2000 type power line carrier was RMB 45,700 per unit. Aite Company produced a total of 11 SSB-2000 type power line carriers, with an output value of RMB 502,700. Calculated at an average profit margin of 37.06%, the profit should be RMB 186,300. On July 28, 1996, this product of Aite Company passed the inspection of the Power Line Carrier Quality Inspection and Testing Center of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry.

During the proceedings, the court commissioned experts to conduct a technical appraisal of the products of both parties. The appraisal found that the SSB-2000 type power line carrier produced by Defendant Aite Company had 15 or more similarities in mechanical structure compared with the ESB-500 type single-sideband power line carrier of Plaintiff XJ Company, including key components such as the IFC intermediate frequency transmission plug-in, the intermediate frequency filter of the IFR intermediate frequency reception plug-in, and the pilot display mode of the AGC pilot control plug-in, which were consistent with the ESB-500 type. The conclusion was that the SSB-2000 type power line carrier produced by Aite Company used proprietary technology of XJ Company's ESB-500 type single-sideband power line carrier in its mechanical structure and some key components.

It was further found that Plaintiff XJ Company incurred investigation costs of RMB 2,150 and attorney consultation and agency fees of RMB 25,000 for this case.

The above facts are confirmed by the "License and Technical Know-How Contract for Relay Protection Power Line Carrier Equipment" signed between XJ Company and Siemens AG of Germany, payment invoices, Zheng Xuesheng's personal resume, the "Comprehensive Labor Contract" signed between Zheng Xuesheng and XJ Company, the "Appraisal Certificate for Scientific and Technological Achievements," the industrial and commercial registration materials of Aite Company, the "Inspection Report" of the Power Line Carrier Quality Inspection and Testing Center of the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, and the "Expert Technical Appraisal Report."

**Opinion of the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court:** The Plaintiff XJ Company acquired the production technology for power line carriers from Siemens AG of Germany through a paid technology transfer contract, conducted domestic development of the technology, and produced the ESB-500 type single-sideband power line carrier product. This product brought significant economic benefits to XJ Company. XJ Company implemented a series of confidentiality measures regarding the power line carrier production technology and never transferred or disclosed the technology to any third party in any manner. Pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, this technology constitutes a trade secret of XJ Company and shall be protected by law. Defendant Zheng Xuesheng, having acquired this trade secret by virtue of his position, violated XJ Company's confidentiality regulations, and while still employed by XJ Company, co-founded Defendant Aite Company, used the technology without compensation to produce and sell products, thereby infringing upon XJ Company's legitimate rights and interests. This constitutes conduct prohibited by Article 10(1)(iii) of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law. Defendant Aite Company, knowing that the power line carrier technology was XJ Company's technical secret, in order to use the technology without compensation to produce products and obtain commercial benefits, induced Zheng Xuesheng to divulge the technical secret by means of valuing it as a capital contribution. Such conduct of obtaining the right holder's trade secrets by improper means is prohibited by Article 10(1)(i) of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law. Pursuant to Article 20(1) of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, Zheng Xuesheng and Aite Company shall bear liability for ceasing the infringement and compensating for losses. The request of XJ Company for an order against the two Defendants to cease infringement and compensate for losses should be supported. The request of XJ Company for an order that Zheng Xuesheng compensate for losses caused by his unilateral termination of the contract pertains to labor disputes and should be handled in a separate case. Accordingly, on June 12, 1997, the Xuchang Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

1. Defendant Zheng Xuesheng and Defendant Aite Company shall immediately cease the infringement from the date this judgment takes effect, shall not use the Plaintiff XJ Company's power line carrier technology for production and business activities, and shall bear the duty of confidentiality regarding the technical secrets of XJ Company that they have learned;
2. Defendant Zheng Xuesheng and Defendant Aite Company shall jointly and severally compensate the Plaintiff XJ Company for economic losses of RMB 213,450, to be satisfied within 15 days after this judgment takes effect;
3. The remaining claims of the Plaintiff XJ Company are dismissed.

Litigation costs of this case of RMB 27,510 shall be borne by the Plaintiff XJ Company in the amount of RMB 7,510, and by Defendant Zheng Xuesheng and Defendant Aite Company in the amount of RMB 20,000. Appraisal fees of RMB 11,076 shall be borne by Zheng Xuesheng and Aite Company.

Zheng Xuesheng, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to the Henan High People's Court. Main grounds of appeal: The power line carrier production technology has long been widely known and is not a trade secret. Aite Company's product uses triple modulation technology in principle, which is a product of a different era from XJ Company's product. The appellant's technology investment and Aite Company's products have no causal relationship with XJ Company. XJ Company claimed compensation of over RMB 3.7 million, but the first instance recognized only a very small portion, and even that portion lacks evidence and cannot be established, indicating that XJ Company abused its litigation rights. The first instance ruling that we bear the litigation costs for XJ Company's abuse of rights is unreasonable. Appeal is requested to ascertain the facts and amend the judgment. Concurrently with the appeal, Zheng Xuesheng submitted to the appellate court a technical evaluation opinion commissioned by Henan Fawei Law Firm in October 1997, prepared by four experts from Beijing, comparing the SSB-2000 type power line carrier produced by Aite Company with the ESB-500X type single-sideband power line carrier produced by XJ Company. The opinion stated that power line carriers have now become specialized, standardized, and general-purpose products, with corresponding monographs published as early as 1992; therefore, products of various manufacturers sold on the market inevitably have some degree of similarity. Compared with the ESB-500X type, the SSB-2000 type has significant differences in technical content.

In the second instance, the Henan High People's Court found that the SSB-2000 type power line carrier listed on the communication products quotation sheet published by the defendant at first instance, Aite Company, had 4 models and 10 different specifications, with reference prices ranging from RMB 28,000 to RMB 58,000, and an average price of RMB 35,700 per unit. Of the 11 SSB-2000 type power line carriers produced by Aite Company, 6 had been sold, with sales revenue of RMB 168,000 and a profit of RMB 62,160. In the evaluation commissioned by Henan Fawei Law Firm from four Beijing experts, the main evaluation materials provided were: the ESB-500X type single-sideband power line carrier sub-panel wiring diagram and instruction manual; the SSB-2000 type power line carrier technical instruction manual; and a physical sample of the SSB(SPC)-2000 type power line carrier. The law firm did not provide the experts with a physical sample of the ESB-500 type power line carrier or complete drawings of both products. The physical sample of the power line carrier provided was not the product of Aite Company preserved by court order at first instance. Except for these findings, the facts found in the second instance were basically consistent with those in the first instance.

**Opinion of the Henan High People's Court:** The ESB-500 type power line carrier technology is a technical secret of the appellee XJ Company and shall be protected by law. No entity or individual may use or transfer such technology without the permission of XJ Company. Appellant Zheng Xuesheng participated in the establishment of the defendant at first instance, Aite Company, during his tenure at XJ Company, and subsequently breached the confidentiality agreement with XJ Company by valuing the job-related technical achievements he had mastered as a capital contribution and using XJ Company's power line carrier production technology to produce SSB-2000 type power line carriers for Aite Company. Such conduct constitutes an infringement of disclosing and using XJ Company's trade secrets and harming XJ Company's legitimate rights and interests, for which he shall bear civil liability to cease the infringement and compensate for losses. Aite Company, knowing that Zheng Xuesheng was an employee of XJ Company and that the technology he possessed was not his personal non-job-related technology, induced Zheng Xuesheng to use this technology to produce products for it and sell them by means of valuing it as a capital contribution, without a legitimate transfer. Such conduct constitutes obtaining another person's trade secrets by improper competitive means and infringing upon another person's legitimate rights and interests, for which it shall bear civil liability to cease the infringement and compensate the injured party for losses. The first instance judgment ordering Zheng Xuesheng and Aite Company to cease infringement and compensate for losses was correct; however, the determination of the profits obtained by Aite Company through infringement and the losses of XJ Company was erroneous and should be corrected. The fact that the power line carrier production technology was acquired by XJ Company from Siemens AG of Germany for consideration indicates that the technology was not public knowledge at the time. The fact that Aite Company agreed to accept this technology as a capital contribution valued at RMB 200,000 from Zheng Xuesheng indicates that the technology was not public knowledge even at the time of the litigation. It was only because of XJ Company's technical secret that Aite Company was able to produce the SSB-2000 type power line carrier in a short period, without any other researchers engaged in power line carrier work besides Zheng Xuesheng, and without conducting "reverse engineering" on XJ Company's products. Therefore, the defense that "Zheng Xuesheng's technology investment and Aite Company's products have no causal relationship with XJ Company's technical secret" cannot be sustained. The expert evaluation opinion submitted by Zheng Xuesheng during the second instance was made without complete drawings of the two products and with a physical sample that was not the product at issue in this case; it lacks objectivity and comparability and cannot be adopted. The argument by Zheng Xuesheng that the first instance finding of XJ Company's losses lacked evidence is reasonable and should be adopted. XJ Company's claims were not fully supported; it should bear a portion of the litigation costs. Accordingly, on March 27, 1998, the Henan High People's Court, pursuant to Article 153(1)(iii) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment:

1. Affirm Items 1 and 3 of the first-instance judgment; set aside Item 2;
2. Zheng Xuesheng and Aite Company shall jointly and severally compensate XJ Company for economic losses of RMB 62,160.

First-instance litigation costs of RMB 27,510 and appraisal fees of RMB 11,076 shall be borne by Zheng Xuesheng and Aite Company in the amount of RMB 27,010, and by XJ Company in the amount of RMB 11,575; second-instance litigation costs of RMB 27,510 shall be borne by Zheng Xuesheng in the amount of RMB 19,257, and by XJ Company in the amount of RMB 8,253.
